headline: Stocks to Watch: Dixon, Ramkrishna Forgings, Bank of Baroda in focus
summary: Dixon Technologies slips 4.25% as Q2 profit falls 45% despite revenue growth. Ramkrishna Forgings rallies on 843% profit jump. Bank of Baroda retreats slightly after strong earnings.

headline: IOC Q2 results: net profit at 216.3b rupees vs loss QoQ
summary: Indian Oil Corporation swung to a net profit of 216.3b rupees in Q2 from a loss of 26.61b rupees in Q1. EBITDA surged to 302.96b rupees with margin expanding to 11.52% from 0.93% QoQ.

headline: Apollo Micro deposits ₹986.35 crore for PEL stake
summary: Apollo Micro Systems deposited ₹986.35 crore into an escrow account for its open offer to acquire a 26% stake in Premier Explosives Limited.

headline: Hikal signs multi-year global CDMO deal
summary: Hikal Limited has signed a multi-year contract with a Europe-based agrochemical firm for specialised product supply. Commercial launch is expected by end of FY27.

headline: Ashok Leyland Oct 2026 sales rise 23% to 21,888 units
summary: Ashok Leyland reported total vehicle sales of 21,888 units in October 2026, a 23% YoY increase. Domestic M&HCV truck volumes surged 39%, driving strong cumulative growth.

headline: Muthoot Finance Q2 net profit up 34% YoY
summary: Muthoot Finance reported Q2 net profit of 32.5B rupees, up from 24.2B YoY, while revenue rose to 99.98B rupees from 72.8B in the same period last year.

headline: Bajaj Auto Oct-26 sales rise 14% YoY to 5.92 lakh units
summary: Bajaj Auto reported total sales of 5,91,876 units in October 2026, a 14% increase from October 2025. Exports drove growth with an 18% YoY rise.

headline: FMCG sales grow 15% in October ahead of Diwali
summary: FMCG sales rose 15% in October, driven by rural growth of 17% and urban growth of 11%, both at multi-month highs, ahead of the Diwali festive season.

headline: Adani Ports cargo volume jumps 27% in Oct'26
summary: Adani Ports handled 51 MMT of cargo in October 2026, marking a 27% year-on-year increase driven by strong growth in dry cargo and containers.

headline: Balu Forge secures US, Europe orders
summary: Balu Forge Industries executes defence orders, clears 155mm artillery milestone, and wins contracts from US oil & gas and Czech armoured vehicle makers.

headline: M&M tractor sales fall in October vs year ago
summary: Mahindra & Mahindra reported October tractor total sales of 64,846 units, down from 73,660 units in the same month a year ago, missing the estimate of 68,900 units.

headline: VST Tillers Oct sales fall YoY in both segments
summary: VST Tillers Tractors reported lower October sales across both power tillers and tractors, with power tiller volumes falling to 3,114 units and tractor volumes declining to 405 units YoY.

headline: India medicine sales grow 12% in October 2026
summary: India's medicine sales grew 12% in October 2026, driven by increased demand for chronic-care treatments, signalling a broad-based uptick in the domestic pharmaceutical market.

headline: L&T targets 15%+ revenue growth at LTM and LTTS
summary: Larsen & Toubro aims to accelerate revenue growth at its services arms LTM and LTTS to over 15%, up from the current 10-11%, targeting stronger business expansion.

headline: Diesel sales up 11.7% in October on festive demand
summary: Diesel sales rose 11.7% YoY in October driven by festive demand, while ATF sales fell 1.3% and LPG sales declined 12.1% YoY during the same period.

headline: HSBC upgrades Bank of Baroda to Buy, target ₹286
summary: HSBC upgraded Bank of Baroda to Buy with a target price of ₹286, citing a Q2FY27 core PAT beat driven by higher core fee income and lower credit costs, excluding an ad hoc ₹1600 crore provision.

headline: Reliance Industries shares flag large-trade signal
summary: A large-trade signal flagged approximately 12,31,983 Reliance Industries shares changing hands on NSE at ₹1,220.40, with a combined value of ₹150.35 crore.

headline: Dixon Tech targets 60M mobile units in FY28
summary: Dixon Technologies executive expressed confidence in achieving mobile volumes of 60 million units in FY28 and 70 million units in FY29, signalling strong growth momentum in its mobile segment.

headline: Steel Strips Wheels logs record Oct sales
summary: Steel Strips Wheels reported highest-ever monthly sales of ₹753.65 crore in October 2026, up 56.69% YoY. Exports surged 179%, driven by strong OEM demand and EV adoption.

headline: Gangotri Textiles postpones Q2FY27 board meeting
summary: Gangotri Textiles Ltd has postponed its board meeting from October 31, 2026, to November 11, 2026, due to the health of its suspended MD. The meeting will consider Q2FY27 results.

headline: Aster DM Quality Care: ₹61.78 crore BSE block trade
summary: A block trade of approximately 900,000 shares of Aster DM Quality Care was executed on BSE at ₹686.50 per share, amounting to ₹61.78 crore.

headline: L&T wins significant contract worth ₹10B-₹25B
summary: Larsen & Toubro has secured a significant contract, with the contract value ranging between ₹10 billion and ₹25 billion, marking a notable order win for the company.

headline: BSE fines Patel Chem Specialities ₹1.22 lakh
summary: BSE levied a fine of ₹1,22,720 on Patel Chem Specialities for alleged non-compliance with Regulation 34 regarding annual report filing.

headline: Kirloskar Pneumatic GM Vijay Kumar Nudurumati retires
summary: Kirloskar Pneumatic Company Ltd announced the cessation of Mr. Vijay Kumar Nudurumati, General Manager Projects & Defense, due to superannuation on November 1, 2026.

headline: Reliance Industries block trade of ₹101.01 crore on NSE
summary: A block trade of approximately 809,374 shares of Reliance Industries was executed on the NSE at ₹1,248.00 per share, totalling ₹101.01 crore.

headline: India manufacturing PMI dips to 54.7 in October
summary: India's HSBC Manufacturing PMI edged down to 54.7 in October from 54.9 in the previous period, signalling continued but slightly softer expansion in the sector.

headline: SEBI warns PC Jeweller executives over database lapse
summary: SEBI issued administrative warning letters to PC Jeweller's MD and CS for failing to maintain a structured digital database for Q1FY26 business updates.

headline: SML Mahindra board to decide on fund raising
summary: SML Mahindra Ltd board meets Nov 6, 2026, to consider equity fund raising via rights, preferential, or QIP under SEBI ICDR regulations.

headline: PVV Infra takes possession of two MP highway sites
summary: PVV Infra Limited has taken physical possession of two Wayside Amenities sites in Madhya Pradesh under a DBOT lease. The company can now begin development following the appointed date declaration.

headline: GRSE board meeting rescheduled to Nov 11
summary: Garden Reach Shipbuilders & Engineers Ltd has rescheduled its board meeting to November 11, 2026, to consider Q2FY27 financial results. The trading window remains closed until November 13.

headline: Gala Precision commissions 1.20 MW solar plant
summary: Gala Precision Engineering Limited commissioned a 1.20 MW open access solar power plant in Nanded, Maharashtra, on October 30, 2026, to support captive consumption.

headline: Coforge shares flag large-trade signal on NSE
summary: A large-trade signal flagged approximately 307,319 Coforge shares changing hands on NSE at ₹2103.10, with a combined value of ₹64.63 crore.

headline: Jindal Poly files NCLT petition against Brookfield affiliate
summary: Jindal Poly Films filed a petition alleging oppression by Project Holdings Fourteen regarding its subsidiary JPFL Films. The dispute involves alleged mismanagement and concurrent arbitration proceedings initiated by the investor.

headline: Andhra Cements posts wider Q2FY27 loss
summary: Andhra Cements Limited reported a net loss of ₹3,835 lakh in Q2FY27, widening from ₹4,184 lakh in Q2FY25. Revenue rose 112% YoY to ₹16,693 lakh.

headline: Vedant Poly Fabs IPO opens at 0.01x on Day 1
summary: Vedant Poly Fabs IPO opened on 2 November 2026 with a total subscription of 0.01x on Day 1. Retail and NII categories each recorded 0.01x; QIB saw no bids.

headline: Antala Industries IPO Day 3: Subscribed 0.97x
summary: Antala Industries IPO sees QIB demand at 66.72x on Day 3, while Retail and NII categories remain under-subscribed at 0.21x and 0.56x respectively.

headline: Maxwell Engineering IPO Day 2: Subscribed 26.39x
summary: Maxwell Engineering Solutions IPO sees massive retail demand on Day 2, with overall subscription hitting 26.39x. Retail leads at 37.84x while QIB remains at 0x.

headline: Vectras Enprocon IPO Day 2: Subscribed 1.31x
summary: Vectras Enprocon IPO sees steady demand on Day 2, closing at 1.31x overall subscription. QIB leads with 1.42x, while Retail stands at 1.22x.

headline: HGS IPO Day 2: Subscribed 7.06x; NII leads demand
summary: HGS IPO sees strong momentum on Day 2 with overall subscription at 7.06x. Non-Institutional Buyers (bHNI) lead with 9.76x, while Retail stands at 7.68x.

headline: Infosys sees ₹55.19 crore block trade on NSE
summary: A block trade of approximately 469,549 shares of Infosys was executed on the NSE at ₹1,175.40 per share, amounting to ₹55.19 crore in total transaction value.

headline: Ambuja Cements plans ₹14,500 crore capacity expansion
summary: Ambuja Cements announces a ₹14,500 crore capex to add 30 MTPA capacity, targeting 155 MTPA by FY30. Expansion focuses on East, West, and North clusters.

headline: Shiva Texyarn President resigns effective Oct 31
summary: G K Raman, President-Strategic Affairs at Shiva Texyarn, resigned due to personal reasons. His cessation is effective from the closing hours of business on October 31, 2026.

headline: HDFC AMC schedules four investor meets in Nov 2026
summary: HDFC Asset Management Company will attend CITIC CLSA, JM Financial, Avendus Spark, and Kotak conferences in Mumbai from November 16 to 26, 2026.

headline: Manav Bahri acquires 32.36% stake in Kuber Udyog
summary: Manav Bahri acquired a 32.36% stake in Kuber Udyog Limited via preferential allotment, increasing his holding from nil to over 31% in equity shares.

headline: Bharat Global Developers defers Q2FY27 results
summary: Bharat Global Developers Ltd deferred its Q2FY27 financial results due to unprepared statements. The board also approved shifting its registered office within Ahmedabad.

headline: Storage Tech CEO and CFO cease office Nov 2026
summary: Afzal Hussain and Nuumaan Khasim have ceased their roles as CEO and CFO of Storage Technologies & Automation Ltd upon tenure completion on November 1, 2026.

headline: Century Plyboards starts commercial production at Hoshiarpur unit
summary: Century Plyboards announced the commencement of commercial production at its new plywood manufacturing unit in Hoshiarpur, Punjab, effective November 2, 2026.

headline: Novus Loyalty opts for voluntary quarterly disclosures
summary: Novus Loyalty Ltd board approved voluntary quarterly financial results from Dec 2026. SME listing rules mandate only half-yearly reporting.

headline: Coal production jumps 42% YoY to 22 MT in October 2026
summary: Coal production rose 42% YoY to 22 MT in October 2026, while dispatches climbed 36% to 21.1 MT, reflecting stronger mining operations and higher capacity utilisation.

headline: Atul Auto October sales rise to 4,204 units YoY
summary: Atul Auto reported total sales of 4,204 units in October, up from 4,012 units in the same month last year, reflecting a year-on-year volume increase.

headline: Artificial Electronics withdraws ₹166 cr rights issue
summary: Artificial Electronics Intelligent Material Ltd has withdrawn its proposed rights issue of ₹166.02 crore due to unfavourable market conditions and volatility.

headline: Delhi HC stays NPPA recovery for AstraZeneca
summary: Delhi High Court halts NPPA coercive steps against AstraZeneca Pharma India over ₹151 crore alleged overcharging in Symbicort case until January 2027.

headline: Indogulf Cropsciences Q2FY27 Net Profit Jumps 24% YoY
summary: Indogulf Cropsciences reported a 24% YoY rise in consolidated net profit to ₹256.84 million for Q2FY27, driven by strong revenue growth and improved margins.

headline: Devyani International Q2 EBITDA up 21% YoY
summary: Devyani International reported Q2 EBITDA of ₹2.32 billion, up from ₹1.92 billion YoY. Net loss narrowed significantly to ₹2 million from ₹220 million.

headline: Titan board to consider NCD issuance on Nov 5
summary: Titan Company's board will meet on November 5, 2026, to evaluate a proposal for issuing rated, listed, redeemable, unsecured Non-Convertible Debentures via private placement.

headline: Capillary Q2FY27: Consolidated PAT jumps to ₹219 crore
summary: Capillary Technologies reports strong Q2FY27 results with consolidated revenue up 51% YoY to ₹2,714 crore. Standalone profit hits ₹294 crore as margins expand significantly.

headline: Rajesh Power H1FY27 PAT up 35% to ₹78.50 lakh
summary: Rajesh Power Services reported a 35% YoY rise in standalone PAT for H1FY27. Revenue grew 46% to ₹92.93 crore, driven by EPC project execution.

headline: Atlanta Electricals Q2FY27 profit up 31%
summary: Atlanta Electricals reported a 31% YoY rise in standalone net profit to ₹39.52 crore in Q2FY27, driven by 23% revenue growth to ₹395.31 crore.

headline: SEBI proposes LTCG exemption for MF reinvestments
summary: SEBI has suggested exempting mutual fund investors from long-term capital gains tax when they sell existing holdings to reinvest in new ones, potentially easing the tax burden on fund switches.

headline: LIC Housing targets full recovery of ₹1,330 crore from Zee
summary: LIC Housing Finance expects to fully recover ₹1,330 crore from Zee Group via South Mumbai property auctions and reaffirms FY27 NIM guidance of 2.5% to 2.6%.

headline: HCLTech launches AI-powered mainframe operations
summary: HCL Technologies introduced an AI-powered operations offering for mainframes, featuring specialized agents and conversational AI to enhance efficiency and observability in mission-critical environments.

headline: Shera Energy H1 net profit doubles YoY to 245M rupees
summary: Shera Energy reported H1 consolidated net profit of 245M rupees, up from 120M rupees YoY, while revenue rose to 10B rupees from 7.8B rupees in the same period.

headline: JTL Industries Q2 profit rises 46% to ₹290 million
summary: JTL Industries reported a 46% jump in standalone net profit to ₹290 million for Q2, driven by a 44% surge in revenue to ₹5.33 billion.

headline: Baheti Recycling H1 net profit doubles to ₹191m
summary: Baheti Recycling Industries reported a net profit of ₹191 million in H1, up from ₹93 million YoY. EBITDA doubled to ₹424 million with margins expanding to 8%.

headline: Bombay Coated & Special Steels IPO Day 3 Update
summary: Bombay Coated & Special Steels IPO sees massive surge on Day 3, with total subscription hitting 16.04x. NII demand leads the pack.

headline: Emami Realty releases VP Legal early
summary: Emami Realty Limited has released Mr. Priyankar Dasgupta from services effective October 31, 2026, advancing his cessation date from the originally notified December 17.

headline: Captain Technocast H1FY27 results: PAT dips to ₹511 lakh
summary: Captain Technocast reported standalone net profit of ₹511.20 lakh for H1FY27, down from ₹573.13 lakh in H1FY26. Revenue fell 3.4% YoY to ₹5,054.55 lakh.

headline: Sukhjit Starch to set up 1,200 TPD maize unit
summary: Sukhjit Starch & Chemicals plans a 1,200 TPD maize processing unit in Maharashtra with a project cost of ₹550 crore. MIDC has confirmed infrastructure and water supply.

headline: Hero Motocorp shares flag large-trade signal on BSE
summary: A large-trade signal flagged approximately 48,947 Hero Motocorp shares changing hands on BSE at ₹5170.00, with combined value of ₹25.31 crore.

headline: Winsome Textile Q2FY27 PAT up 48% YoY
summary: Winsome Textile Industries Ltd reported a 48.3% YoY rise in Q2FY27 net profit to ₹992 lakh, driven by 27.1% revenue growth.

headline: Gopal Snacks to host investor meet in Mumbai
summary: Gopal Snacks Limited will hold one-on-one and group meetings with five institutional investors and analysts in Mumbai on November 5, 2026.

headline: Capillary appoints Deloitte as internal auditor
summary: Capillary Technologies India Ltd has appointed Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu India LLP as its internal auditor, replacing Protiviti. The move aims to strengthen governance for global operations.

headline: Nirlon Ltd board modifies dividend policy
summary: Nirlon Limited's Board approved modifications to its Dividend Distribution Policy on November 2, 2026, aligning with SEBI LODR amendments regarding electronic dividend payments.

headline: Zydus Lifesciences completes Sterling Biotech API acquisition
summary: Zydus Lifesciences Limited has completed the acquisition of the API business of Sterling Biotech Limited. The deal closed on November 2, 2026, following the fulfillment of conditions precedent.

headline: Oasis Securities Q2FY27 PAT falls 67% YoY
summary: Oasis Securities Ltd reported a standalone net profit of ₹7.83 lakh for Q2FY27, down 67% YoY. Revenue rose 380% to ₹228 lakh, but impairment charges surged to ₹211.48 lakh.

headline: Nirlon Q2FY27 Results: EBITDA up 2.7% YoY
summary: Nirlon Ltd reported a 2.7% YoY rise in EBITDA to ₹1,365 million for Q2FY27. PAT fell 51.3% YoY due to tax base effects, while occupancy remained at 99.8%.

headline: Mega Fin changes RTA to Purva Sharegistry
summary: Mega Fin India Ltd board approved changing its Registrar and Share Transfer Agent from Bigshare Services to Purva Sharegistry to strengthen investor services.

headline: UFBL Q2 net loss narrows to ₹61 million
summary: United Foodbrands Ltd reported a consolidated net loss of ₹61 million in Q2, a significant improvement from the ₹222 million loss recorded in the same quarter last year.

headline: Paluck Tech H1FY27 PAT up 42% YoY
summary: Paluck Technologies reported a 41.6% YoY rise in net profit to ₹508.76 lakh for H1FY27. Revenue from operations grew 33.6% to ₹5,103.87 lakh.

headline: MobiKwik turns profitable in Q2 with ₹118m net profit
summary: MobiKwik reported a consolidated net profit of ₹118 million in Q2, reversing a loss of ₹286 million in the year-ago period. Revenue rose to ₹2.96 billion from ₹2.7 billion.

headline: Themis Medicare board meet moved to Nov 14
summary: Themis Medicare rescheduled its board meeting to November 14, 2026, to approve Q2FY27 results. The trading window remains closed for designated persons.

headline: Mastek to host WhiteOak AMC investor meet Nov 2
summary: Mastek Limited scheduled a virtual single-investor meet with WhiteOak AMC on November 2, 2026, at 4:00 pm. Discussions will cover public domain developments.

headline: Digicontent Q2FY27: PAT falls 55% YoY to ₹4.27 lakh
summary: Digicontent Limited reported a 55% YoY decline in consolidated net profit for Q2FY27. Revenue from operations grew slightly, but other expenses rose significantly, impacting margins.

headline: Nava Ltd shuts 150MW Paloncha plant for maintenance
summary: Nava Limited announced a temporary shutdown of its 150MW Paloncha power plant for annual maintenance starting November 2, 2026. Operations are expected to resume in 30 days.

headline: Lyka Labs fined ₹1.62 lakh by NSE
summary: Lyka Labs received a ₹1,62,000 fine from NSE for delayed FY26 annual report submission. The company stated the delay was inadvertent and has since submitted the report.

headline: Sicagen Q2FY27 net profit jumps 122% YoY
summary: Sicagen India Ltd reported a 122% YoY rise in standalone net profit to ₹481 lakh for Q2FY27. Revenue from operations grew 24% YoY to ₹1,546 crore.

headline: PCBL Chemical Q2FY27 PAT up 34% to ₹80 crore
summary: PCBL Chemical reported a 34% YoY rise in standalone net profit to ₹80.01 crore for Q2FY27, driven by 15% revenue growth.

headline: Cyient DLM to hold investor call with WestBridge Capital
summary: Cyient DLM Limited will participate in a virtual analyst and investor meeting with WestBridge Capital on November 5, 2026, at 11:30 am IST.

headline: Tata Teleservices Maharashtra initiates e-voting for director appointment
summary: Tata Teleservices (Maharashtra) Limited has commenced remote e-voting for the appointment of Gaurav Gupta as Non-Executive Non-Independent Director. The voting period runs from November 3 to December 2, 2026.

headline: Kalpataru subsidiary acquires 16.67% stake in Agile entities
summary: Kalpataru Properties Ltd, a wholly owned subsidiary, approved the acquisition of 16.67% equity in Agile Real Estate Private Limited and Agile Real Estate Dev Private Limited for ₹52.54 crore.

headline: Lodha Developers targets ₹30B pre-sales in Bengaluru FY27
summary: Lodha Developers expects pre-sales of ₹30B in Bengaluru for FY27, signalling a significant push into the city's residential real estate market.

headline: Persistent Systems shares flag large trade on NSE
summary: A large-trade signal flagged ~1,02,088 Persistent Systems shares changing hands on NSE at ₹6,091.50, with a combined value of ₹62.19 crore.

headline: Eureka Forbes Q2 net profit up 17.8% to ₹741 million
summary: Eureka Forbes reported a 17.8% YoY rise in consolidated net profit to ₹741 million, driven by 15.6% revenue growth to ₹8.9 billion and margin expansion.

headline: Baroda Extrusion cancels Q2FY27 earnings call
summary: Baroda Extrusion Ltd cancelled its scheduled earnings call for Q2FY27 results due to unexpected circumstances. The call was set for November 3, 2026.

headline: Stonepeak acquires Castrol India control
summary: Stonepeak Infrastructure Fund V completed the acquisition of Castrol Limited, resulting in indirect sole control of Castrol India Limited. BP retains a 35% stake in the acquiring entity.

headline: Wonderla Q2FY27 PAT falls 99% YoY to ₹5 lakh
summary: Wonderla Holidays reported a sharp decline in Q2FY27 net profit to ₹5.06 lakh despite revenue growth, driven by seasonal factors and rising costs.

headline: Edelweiss subsidiary sells shares in EAAA IPO for ₹1,200 crore
summary: Edelweiss Financial Services subsidiary ESIPL sold 72 lakh shares of EAAA India Alternatives in its IPO. The offer fetched a gross consideration of ₹1,200 crore at ₹1,665 per share.

headline: Zuari Agro Q2FY27: Consolidated profit dips
summary: Zuari Agro Chemicals reported consolidated net profit of ₹37.37 crore for Q2FY27, down from ₹118.70 crore in Q1FY27. Revenue fell to ₹397.72 crore.

headline: Archies appoints Anant Gupta as independent director
summary: Archies Limited appointed Anant Gupta as an Additional Non-Executive Independent Director for five years, effective November 2, 2026. The move includes committee reconstitution.

headline: Alacrity Securities Q2FY27 Results
summary: Alacrity Securities Ltd reported a net loss of ₹71.21 lakh for Q2FY27, swinging from a profit of ₹578.70 lakh in Q2FY26. Revenue from operations fell 55.6% YoY to ₹4,552.94 lakh.

headline: Avonmore Capital Q2FY27 Results
summary: Avonmore Capital & Management Services reports Q2FY27 standalone net profit of ₹22 lakh and consolidated profit of ₹1,091 lakh. Consolidated revenue rose 19% YoY to ₹4,411 lakh.

headline: NBCC to develop Haldighati tourist circuit
summary: NBCC (India) Ltd will develop the Maharana Pratap Tourist Circuit at Haldighati, Rajasthan. The project has a sanctioned cost of approx. ₹168.39 crore.

headline: Oswal Leasing Q2FY27 Losses Widen
summary: Oswal Leasing Limited reported a net loss of ₹1.43 lakh for Q2FY27, widening from ₹1.07 lakh in the previous quarter. Interest income declined year-on-year.

headline: MMP Industries Q2 profit jumps 78% to ₹107 million
summary: MMP Industries reported a 78% YoY rise in Q2 net profit to ₹107 million, driven by 32.6% revenue growth and improved EBITDA margins.

headline: Epigral Q2 net profit rises 27% to ₹651 million
summary: Epigral reported a 27% YoY rise in consolidated net profit to ₹651 million. Revenue grew 25% to ₹7.4 billion, though EBITDA margin contracted to 18.3%.

headline: Mold-Tek Packaging Q2 EBITDA rises to ₹506 million
summary: Mold-Tek Packaging reported Q2 EBITDA of ₹506 million, up from ₹391 million YoY. Net profit rose to ₹211 million, while margins slightly contracted.

headline: BCL Industries Q2 net profit falls 27% YoY
summary: BCL Industries reported a 27% YoY decline in net profit to ₹155 million, despite revenue rising 3% to ₹4.9 billion in Q2.
